headline: How to Ensure Your Cabinet Quote is Complete
articleBody: Getting a quote for new cabinets can sometimes feel a bit like reading a foreign language, and it's easy to overlook crucial details. To make sure you're getting a complete picture and avoiding any nasty surprises later on, you've got to ask the right questions. First off, pin down exactly what materials are included – this covers everything from the wood type to the hardware. You also need to know about design and customization options; what's possible, and what's extra? Then, clarify whether installation is part of the package or if it's a separate cost. Another big one: what does the warranty cover, and for how long? And don't forget to get a realistic timeline for design to installation, including lead times. A common mistake is accepting vague answers here. A professional will be able to provide clear answers to all these points, coordinate measurements and other trades, and offer full price transparency. You want someone who gives you all the details, not just a bottom-line number. Don't be shy about asking—it’s your home and your investment!
